description: Source code for managing persistent session data in the Unvanquished game, including functions for reading, writing, and initializing client session data across game levels and reconnects.

methods.name: G_WriteClientSessionData
methods.description: Saves a client's session data into a cvar for persistence.

methods.name: G_ReadSessionData
methods.description: Reads a client's session data from a cvar upon reconnect.

methods.name: G_InitSessionData
methods.description: Initializes a new client's session data on first connect.

methods.name: G_WriteSessionData
methods.description: Saves all clients' session data, typically called on game shutdown.
